newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Intertie 600 MW rise seen midnight Tues.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Intertie 600 MW rise seen midnight Tues.

text.p: Capacity on the Pacific Intertie is tentatively scheduled to increase by 600 megawatts (MW) to 6,900 MW as of midnight Tuesday, a spokeswoman for the Western Systems Coordinating Council (WSCC) said Friday.
She noted the plan is contingent on software modifications being in place and on the distribution of procedures to system operators, although these steps are expected to be finished on time.
The increase in the interstate transmission system's capacity was approved by the WSCC last week, but a technical group did not finish until Friday a review of necessary operating procedures.
